description: Ministry of Urban Development Water Supply and Drainage - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable properties in Rambuke Ela, Akurana D/S Division and in Girakaduwa and Udathalawinna, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District for the Constructions under Kandy North - Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project and in Nivithigala, Nivithigala D/S Division, Ratnapura District for the constructions under Nivithigala Water Supply Scheme
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for water supply projects, including property boundaries, survey details, and claimant information. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette.
